items.source_en:
* A Gonk droid walks into a bar. Bartender says, “What’ll it be?” The droid says, “Gonk.” Bartender nods and says, “Coming right up.”

* Knock knock. Who’s there? Hutt. Hutt who? Hutt do you mean, you don’t take bribes?

* How many Jawas does it take to fix a speeder? One—but you’ll have to buy it back from him first.

* Why did the Ewok refuse to fight? He thought it was a little overbear-ing.

* A Bothan, a smuggler, and a droid walk into a bar. Only the droid walks out.

* How do you tell if a Rodian is lying?
Don’t worry, he’ll tell you after you’ve already paid him.

* What do you call a Twi’lek who can’t dance?
Unemployed.

[Unlike the first two volumes he published, Louis Lupper's Bad Beings, Worse Jokes Volume 3 never really gained much of an audience. Popular theory suggests that by the time of its release, people were already tired of Lupper's terrible jokes—or perhaps, finally, the jokes were just that bad.]
items.legacy_ko:
* 어느 날 곤크 드로이드가 선술집 칸티나에 들어왔다. 바텐더가 물었다. “뭘로 드릴까요?” 드로이드가 대답했다. “곤크.” 바텐더는 고개를 끄덕이며 말했다. “알겠습니다, 바로 준비해 드리죠.”

* 똑똑. 누구십니까? 헛족입니다. 무슨 헛족이요? 헛소리하지 마십시오, 뇌물을 안 받겠다니 그게 말이 됩니까?

* 자와족이 스피더 한 대를 수리하려면 몇 명이 필요할까? 한 명이면 충분하다. 다만 수리가 끝나면 녀석에게 돈을 주고 당신의 스피더를 다시 사 와야 하겠지만 말이다.

* 이워크가 왜 제국군과의 전투를 거부했는지 아는가? 이 싸움은 자기가 감당하기에 조금 '곰' 씹을 만한 구석이 없다고 생각했기 때문이다.

* 보탄족과 밀수꾼, 그리고 드로이드가 칸티나에 들어갔다. 그리고 오직 드로이드 한 기만이 멀쩡하게 걸어 나왔다.

* 로디안이 당신에게 거짓말을 하고 있는지 어떻게 구별할 수 있을까?
걱정할 필요 전혀 없다. 어차피 당신이 그에게 수수료를 몽땅 지불하고 난 뒤에 본인이 직접 이실직고할 테니까.

* 춤을 전혀 추지 못하는 트윌렉을 뭐라고 부르는지 아는가?
실업자.

[작가 루이스 루퍼가 출판했던 전작 두 권의 대성공과 달리, '못된 지성체들의 더 못된 농담 제3권'은 시장에서 철저하게 외면당하며 거의 독자를 끌어모으지 못했습니다. 호사가들의 평에 따르면, 이 책이 출간될 때쯤 대중들은 이미 루퍼의 이 끔찍하고 썰렁한 유머 코드에 완전히 질려버렸거나, 혹은 마침내 농담들의 질 자체가 도저히 참아주기 힘들 만큼 바닥을 쳤기 때문이라는 설이 지배적입니다.]

items.source_en:
Hayden Wynn - Senior Xenobiologist
Sullust Research Facility
Project Log
August 7th, 2307

After months of testing a variety of extraterrestrial species, I am overjoyed to report that we have finally found a species that will serve as the backbone of the Imperial Xenowarfare Division.

The arthropods are everything we hoped for and more. Imagine a pack of alien beasts, suited to any terrain, capable of instantly obeying any command. 

I have designated these beasts "Obedientes Pes." But we just call them Stalkers.

I think it may finally be time to crack open that bottle of Chateau Avignon 2170.

items.source_en:
When the Lower City of Taris was still young, Bek Base stood as a hidden fortress, a sanctuary for the Hidden Beks swoop gang in their long rivalry against the Black Vulkars. What began as a simple staging ground for swoop races and minor skirmishes became a stronghold of rebellion and survival. To the outsiders of the Upper City, it was little more than a den for outlaws, but for those who lived in the depths of Taris, Bek Base was a symbol of defiance against those who sought to control the underworld.

The passage of time has buried much of the base’s original purpose, but its legend endures. Now, using the latest archaeological surveys and recovered records, we have new insights into the rise and fall of Bek Base, the power struggles that shaped its halls, and how it came to be a battleground for the fate of Taris itself.

[So begins a definitive study on the history of Bek Base, compiled from old gang archives, witness accounts, and recovered datapads from the ruins of the Lower City.]
items.legacy_ko:
타리스의 하층 도시가 아직 젊었을 때, 벡 기지는 블랙 벌카와의 오랜 경쟁 속에서 히든 벡스 스웁 갱단의 은신처이자 요새였습니다. 스웁 레이스와 소규모 교전을 위한 단순한 거점으로 시작된 곳은 점차 반란과 생존의 거점이 되었습니다. 상층 도시의 외부인들에게 이곳은 무법자들의 소굴에 불과했지만, 타리스 깊은 곳에 사는 사람들에게 벡 기지는 지하 세계를 통제하려는 자들에 대한 저항의 상징이었습니다.

When the Ancient World was young, the civilization of Egypt was already old. The Pyramids of Giza still tower over Cairo and awed Roman Legionnaires and Napoleon's soldiers as much as any modern visitor. But it was more than a tourist destination, the fertile Nile was a key bread basket and valuable source of revenue for thousands of years. It's influence on the Mediterranean was and is profound.

Using the latest technology, we have new insights and glimpses into the rise of Ancient Egypt and how its society changed over the many years. So come with us on a trip through the land of Pharaohs and Pyramids.

[So starts a definitive work of the History of Egypt by a collection of unknown archaeologists and anthropologists published in 2133.]
